passages.text: The new bus service has (1) ______ daily life in the village. Earlier, residents had to walk several kilometres to reach the market, and many elderly people (2) ______ at home for days. Now a bus runs every hour, so farmers can sell their produce (3) ______ and children reach school on time every morning. The council (4) ______ the scheme after a survey showed that most families wanted it. Although the fares are low, the service has not yet (5) ______ a profit, and officials are looking for ways to cut costs without reducing the number of trips.

blanks.explanation: The present perfect 'has transformed' needs the past participle and the sense of changing daily life.
The sentence describes the past ('Earlier'), so the past tense 'stayed' is needed.
An adverb is needed to modify the verb 'sell'.
The past tense matches 'showed' and the sense of giving permission.
'Has not yet made a profit' needs the past participle after 'has'.
